root: 来自拉丁语 depositum，源头是 deponere，由 de-（向下）与 ponere（放置）组成。它先指放下或托付之物，十六世纪进入英语指存进银行的钱，十七世纪科学又借它指水留下的沉积层。

sensesIntro.en: From money laid in a safe place, to money laid down as a promise, to sand laid down by a river.
sensesIntro.cn: 从放进安全处的钱，到作为承诺交出的钱，再到河流放下的沙。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coin falls into a tin that already has a thin layer in it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币落进盒底已有一层薄薄东西的铁盒。

branches.en: The first sense is money placed where it will wait.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把钱放在一个会等你的地方。

branches.en: The second sense is money placed as proof of a promise.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是作为承诺凭据放下的钱。

branches.en: The third sense is matter placed by water and forgotten.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是水放下并被遗忘的物质。

branches.en: In a bank and in a landlord's hand, money is put down for later.
branches.cn: 在银行与房东手里，钱都是为了以后而放下。

branches.en: Both a pledge and a sandbank are things left in place.
branches.cn: 承诺的凭据与沙洲，都是留在原处的东西。

intro.en: Deposit grows a family about placing, storing and laying down, from the person to the place.
intro.cn: deposit 长出一族表示放置、储存与沉积的词，从人到地方都有。

latinIntro.en: The base is ponere, to place, with de- meaning down; posit is the same root seen in position.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 ponere（放置），de- 表示向下；posit 这个部分也出现在 position 里。

definition_zh: 沉积；沉积物；宣誓证词；罢免
definition_en: the laying down of material; the material laid down; sworn testimony; or removal from power
core_image: 河水放慢，沙粒一层层落在河底
scene: 春天河湾水流变缓，细沙一层层落下来：The deposition of fine silt each spring keeps the delta fertile.
sceneCN: 这里 deposition 是「沉积作用」（第 1 个义项：物质被放下并堆积）；句意：每年春天细淤泥的沉积让三角洲保持肥沃。图中可辨识物件：河湾、缓流、沉降的细沙、层层叠起的河岸剖面。

pos.zh: 沉积；沉积物；宣誓证词；罢免

senses.title: Sediment laid down by water or wind
senses.titleCN: 沉积作用：颗粒一层层落下来
senses.definition: the geological process by which loose material settles out of water, wind or ice
senses.definitionCN: 松散物质从水、风或冰中沉降并堆积的地质过程
senses.example: Deposition of sand at the river mouth slowly built a new bar.
senses.exampleCN: 河口处的沙子沉积，慢慢堆出一道新沙洲。
senses.why: deponere means 'to put down'. When a current loses energy it puts its load down, so deposition is literally the putting-down of particles.
senses.whyCN: deponere 意为“放下”。水流失去能量时就把负载放下，因此沉积字面上就是颗粒被放下。

senses.title: The material that has settled
senses.titleCN: 沉积物：落下来的那一层
senses.definition: the layer or body of material produced by deposition
senses.definitionCN: 由沉积作用产生的那一层或那一堆物质
senses.example: The cliff exposes a thick deposition of volcanic ash.
senses.exampleCN: 崖壁露出厚厚一层火山灰沉积。
senses.why: The -ion noun can name either the act or its result. Once the particles are down, the same word points to the layer they form.
senses.whyCN: -ion 名词既可指动作，也可指结果。颗粒一旦落下，同一个词就指向它们形成的那一层。

senses.title: Sworn testimony taken out of court
senses.titleCN: 宣誓证词：法庭外的正式口供
senses.definition: a formal statement made under oath before a court officer, usually before trial
senses.definitionCN: 在法院官员面前宣誓作出的正式陈述，通常在开庭前进行
senses.example: The witness gave a deposition that contradicted her earlier statement.
senses.exampleCN: 证人作出的宣誓证词与她早先的说法相矛盾。
senses.why: Legal language borrowed deponere in the sense 'to set down in writing or on record'. A deposition is testimony put down so it cannot be changed later.
senses.whyCN: 法律语言借用了 deponere 的“记录下来”义。证词被“放下”固定住，日后就不能更改。

senses.title: Removal from office
senses.titleCN: 罢免：把掌权者从位子上拿下
senses.definition: the removal of a ruler, bishop or official from power
senses.definitionCN: 把统治者、主教或官员从权力位置上撤下
senses.example: The deposition of the king led to a decade of civil war.
senses.exampleCN: 国王被罢黜引发了一场十年内战。
senses.why: To depose is to put someone down from a seat. The noun keeps that physical picture: the person is lowered out of the position they occupied.
senses.whyCN: depose 就是把某人从位子上拿下。名词保留了这一物理画面：人被从所占据的位置上放下来。

senses.title: Thin films formed from vapour
senses.titleCN: 气相沉积：原子落到基片上
senses.definition: a manufacturing process in which a vapour condenses onto a surface to form a thin film
senses.definitionCN: 蒸气在表面凝结形成薄膜的制造工艺
senses.example: Chemical vapour deposition coats the tools with a hard layer.
senses.exampleCN: 化学气相沉积在刀具上覆上一层硬膜。
senses.why: The industrial sense is the geological sense at atomic scale: particles arrive and settle on a surface, building a layer.
senses.whyCN: 工业义就是地质义在原子尺度上的版本：粒子到达并落在表面，堆成一层。

senses.title: Metal laid down by current
senses.titleCN: 电沉积：金属离子在电极上落户
senses.definition: the electrochemical process in which dissolved metal ions form a solid coating on an electrode
senses.definitionCN: 溶解的金属离子在电极上形成固体镀层的电化学过程
senses.example: Electrodeposition of copper filled the narrow trenches on the chip.
senses.exampleCN: 铜的电沉积填满了芯片上的窄沟槽。
senses.why: Here the particles are ions driven to a surface by current. The word still means 'put down', only the force moving them has changed.
senses.whyCN: 这里的颗粒是被电流驱赶到表面的离子。词义仍是“放下”，只是推动它们的力变了。

senses.title: Pollutants settling on surfaces
senses.titleCN: 污染物沉降：脏东西从空中落下来
senses.definition: the transfer of airborne pollutants onto land, water or buildings
senses.definitionCN: 空气中的污染物转移到土地、水体或建筑物上的过程
senses.example: Nitrogen deposition from nearby farms changed the meadow's plant life.
senses.exampleCN: 附近农场带来的氮沉降改变了草甸的植物群落。
senses.why: Environmental science applies the old word to particles and gases leaving the air. What falls is no longer sand, but the motion is the same.
senses.whyCN: 环境科学把这个旧词用于离开空气的颗粒和气体。落下之物不再是沙子，但运动方式相同。

senses.title: The act of placing something down
senses.definition: the act of laying or placing an object somewhere, often in a ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放置在某处的动作，常用于仪式场合
senses.example: The deposition of wreaths at the memorial takes place at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 纪念仪式上的花圈安放于黎明时进行。
senses.why: This sense stays closest to deponere: an object is put down at a chosen place. Ceremonial use preserves the literal gesture beneath all the technical senses.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项最贴近 deponere：物件被放到选定之处。仪式用法在所有技术义之下保留了字面动作。

intro.en: Deposition goes back to Latin depositio, from deponere 'to put down', itself de- 'down' plus ponere 'to place'. The geological, legal and political senses all preserve that basic downward placement.
intro.cn: deposition 可追到拉丁 depositio，来自 deponere“放下”，由 de-“向下”和 ponere“放置”构成。地质、法律与政治义都保留了“向下放置”这一基本动作。

items.en: ponere meant 'to put, place, set'. It is the source of position, positive, compose, expose and deposit, so the whole family is about placement.
items.cn: ponere 意为“放、安置、摆”。它是 position、positive、compose、expose、deposit 的来源，因此整个词族都围绕“放置”。

items.en: deponere adds de- 'down', giving 'to put down, lay aside, store'. Latin used it for laying down a burden as well as for depositing money or testimony.
items.cn: deponere 加 de-“向下”，意为“放下、搁置、存放”。拉丁语既用它表示放下重担，也表示存放钱款或证词。

items.en: The noun depositio names the act of putting down and, by extension, what has been put down. English takes the stem deposit- and adds -ion.
items.cn: 名词 depositio 命名“放下”的动作，并引申指被放下之物。英语取 deposit- 词干加 -ion。

items.en: From the idea of putting something on record comes the legal deposition: testimony set down under oath. The exact date of this extension is uncertain.
items.cn: 从“记录在案”的观念产生了法律上的 deposition：宣誓后记录下来的证词。这一引申的确切年代存疑。

items.en: Deposing a ruler is putting him down from a seat of power. The political noun appears in medieval and early modern English, again from deponere.
items.cn: 罢黜统治者就是把他从权力座位上拿下。这一政治名词出现于中世纪和近代早期英语，同样来自 deponere。

items.en: Geology adopted deposition for settling sediment in the 18th and 19th centuries; materials science later applied it to thin films. The physical image needed no change.
items.cn: 地质学在 18 至 19 世纪采用 deposition 表示沉积物沉降；材料科学后来把它用于薄膜。物理意象无需改变。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on deposit- with different endings; the near-meaning group separates the kinds of settling, recording and removal the word can name.
note.cn: 形近组由 deposit- 加不同词尾构成；近义组区分这个词所能命名的几种沉降、记录与撤职。

entries.definition: to put money or material somewhere; the material or money put down. It is the everyday member of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 存放钱或物质；被放下的物质或钱款。它是这个词族的日常成员。

entries.definition: relating to deposition, especially in geology. The -al suffix turns the process noun into an adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 与沉积有关的，尤用于地质学。-al 把过程名词变成形容词。

entries.definition: to remove from office, or to testify under oath. It is the verb behind the political and legal senses.
entries.definitionCN: 罢免；宣誓作证。它是政治义与法律义背后的动词。

entries.definition: the process by which sediment settles; it overlaps with geological deposition but focuses on the settling of solids in a fluid.
entries.definitionCN: 沉积物沉降的过程；它与地质沉积重叠，但聚焦于固体在流体中的沉降。

entries.definition: a formal statement of evidence, usually in court; a deposition is one specific kind taken before trial.
entries.definitionCN: 正式的证据陈述，通常在法庭上；deposition 是开庭前取得的特定一种。

entries.definition: the removal of a monarch from the throne; narrower than deposition, which also covers bishops and officials.
entries.definitionCN: 把君主从王座上撤下；比 deposition 窄，后者也涵盖主教与官员。

entries.definition: the gradual gathering of material; it stresses the growing pile rather than the act of laying each particle down.
entries.definitionCN: 物质的逐渐堆积；它强调堆头越来越大，而不是每颗粒被放下的动作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配和真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: de- 'down' + ponere 'place': deposition is a placing down, whether sand, testimony or a crown.
normal.cn: de-“向下”+ ponere“放置”：deposition 就是放下——无论放的是沙、证词还是王冠。

normal.en: deposit, position, compose and expose all share ponere, so the family is a set of placements.
normal.cn: deposit、position、compose、expose 都共享 ponere，整个词族就是一组“放置”。

normal.en: The legal phrase is 'give a deposition', not 'make': the witness hands the record over.
normal.cn: 法律搭配是 give a deposition，而不是 make：证人把记录交出去。

normal.en: In geology, look for the pair deposition and erosion: one builds layers, the other removes them.
normal.cn: 地质学里记住 deposition 与 erosion 这对词：一个铺层，一个剥层。

normal.en: Vapour deposition is the same word at atomic scale: atoms settle on a surface just as sand settles on a riverbed.
normal.cn: 气相沉积是同一个词在原子尺度上：原子落在表面，正如沙落在河床。

abstract.en: Think of a hand opening and letting a fistful of sand fall onto a table in slow motion.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手张开，让一把沙以慢镜头落到桌面上。

abstract.en: Think of dust forming a grey film on a windowsill over weeks of stillness.
abstract.cn: 想象几周无人打扰，灰尘在窗台上积成一层灰膜。

abstract.en: Think of a crown being lifted from a head and set down on a table: that downward move is the political sense.
abstract.cn: 想象王冠被从头上升起，再放到桌上：这个向下的动作就是政治义。

examples.en: Wind deposition created the long dunes along the coast.
examples.cn: 风的沉积作用在海岸边造出了长长的沙丘。

examples.en: The lawyer scheduled a deposition for the following Tuesday.
examples.cn: 律师把宣誓证词安排在下一个星期二。

examples.en: The deposition of the bishop was ordered by the council.
examples.cn: 主教被议会下令罢免。

dict_mnemonic.text: “地破zition”——地（de）上破（po）碎的沙一点点sit（沉积）下来 → deposition 沉积、证词

root: 拉丁 deponere“放下、存放”（de-“向下”+ ponere“放置”）；deposit- 词干 + -ion 名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one downward movement: something is taken from where it was and set down somewhere else, to stay.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个向下动作：某物从原处被取下，放到别处并留在那里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a current slowing and letting its load fall to the bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：水流放慢，让负载落到水底。

branches.en: PROCESS AND RESULT: laying particles down and the layer that results are the same event seen while happening and afterwards.
branches.cn: 过程与结果：把颗粒放下与由此形成的层，是同一事件在发生中与发生后的两种看法。

branches.en: REMOVAL: a ruler or bishop set down from a position of power.
branches.cn: 罢免：把统治者或主教从权力位置上撤下。

branches.en: INDUSTRIAL LAYERS: vapour and electrodeposition build films atom by atom, the geological gesture repeated in a factory.
branches.cn: 工业镀层：气相沉积与电沉积逐原子造膜，是地质动作在工厂里的重复。

branches.en: ENVIRONMENT AND CEREMONY: pollutants falling on land and wreaths laid at a memorial both end with something resting where it was placed.
branches.cn: 环境与仪式：污染物落到土地上、花圈安放在纪念碑前，最终都是某物停在它被放下之处。

branches.en: THE LEGAL CORE: the deposition under oath is the most institutionalised form of 'putting something down so it cannot move'.
branches.cn: 法律核心：宣誓证词是“把东西放下、使其不能移动”最制度化的形式。

intro.en: Deposition is deposit plus -ion. The Latin parts de- and ponere are fused inside the base; English freely adds -ion, -al, -or and -ory to build the family.
intro.cn: deposition 是 deposit 加 -ion。拉丁成分 de- 与 ponere 已融合在词基内；英语可自由加 -ion、-al、-or、-ory 来扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin ponere 'to place' yields deponere 'put down', depositio 'a laying down', and depositum 'something deposited'. English relatives include deposit, position, compose, expose and postpone.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ponere“放置”派生 deponere“放下”、depositio“放下”、depositum“存放物”。英语同族词包括 deposit、position、compose、expose、postpone。

items.meaning: to put down; material or money put down
items.meaningCN: 存放；沉积；存款（de-“向下”+ ponere“放置”）
items.example: The river deposits silt along its lower course.
items.exampleCN: 这条河在下游沿线沉积淤泥。

items.meaning: the act of laying down, or what is laid down
items.meaningCN: 沉积；沉积物（-ion 构成动作或结果名词）
items.example: The deposition of ash buried the old road.
items.exampleCN: 火山灰的沉积掩埋了旧路。

items.meaningCN: 沉积的；与沉积有关的（-al 构成关系形容词）
items.example: The rock shows clear depositional layers.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩石显示出清晰的沉积层。

items.meaning: a person who deposits money or material
items.meaningCN: 存款人；沉积者（-or 构成施事者名词）
items.exampleCN: 每位存款人都拿到了一张收据。

items.meaning: a place where things are stored
items.meaningCN: 存放处；储藏所（-ory 构成处所名词）
items.example: The documents are kept in a secure depository.
items.exampleCN: 这些文件存放在一个安全的储藏所。

items.meaning: to remove from office; to testify
items.meaningCN: 罢免；宣誓作证（由“拿下”引申）
items.example: The council moved to depose the mayor.

items.meaning: to deposit again; to lay down a second time
items.meaningCN: 再次沉积；重新存放（re-“再次”+ deposit）
items.example: The eroded sand was redeposited further downstream.
items.exampleCN: 被侵蚀的沙子在下游更远处再次沉积。

items.meaning: a second laying down of material
items.meaningCN: 再次沉积；再沉积作用（re- + deposition）
items.example: Redeposition thickened the layer near the bend.
items.exampleCN: 再沉积使弯道附近的层变厚。

latinEntries.meaning: to put down; to lay aside; to store

definition_zh: n. 贬值；（会计）折旧；轻视，贬低
definition_en: a fall in the value of an asset or currency, or the writing off of its cost over time
core_image: 一辆新车开出展厅就掉价，账本上每年划掉一笔折旧，汇率牌上的数字往下走
scene: 这台机器的折旧按五年计算。Depreciation on the machine is over five years.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：depreciation 指折旧；句意是这台机器的折旧按五年计算。

pos.zh: 贬值；（会计）折旧；轻视，贬低

senses.title: Fall in value
senses.definition: a fall in the value of an asset or a currency
senses.definitionCN: 资产或货币价值的下降
senses.example: The depreciation of the pound raised import prices.
senses.exampleCN: 英镑贬值推高了进口价格。
senses.why: A rate board with the number moving down.
senses.whyCN: 一块数字往下走的汇率牌。

senses.title: Writing off cost
senses.definition: the spreading of an asset cost over its useful life in accounts
senses.definitionCN: 会计上把资产成本分摊到其使用年限
senses.example: Depreciation on the machine is over five years.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器的折旧按五年计算。
senses.why: A ledger with one sum crossed off each year.
senses.whyCN: 一本每年划掉一笔金额的账簿。

senses.title: Belittling
senses.definition: the act of making something seem less valuable or important
senses.definitionCN: 让某物显得不那么有价值或重要的行为
senses.example: His depreciation of her work was unfair.
senses.exampleCN: 他贬低她的作品是不公平的。
senses.why: A price tag torn off a good painting.
senses.whyCN: 一张从好画上撕下来的价签。

intro.en: Depreciation comes from Latin depretiare, de- plus pretium, price: to push the price down.
intro.cn: depreciation 源自拉丁语 depretiare，由 de- 加 pretium（价格）构成：把价格往下压。

items.en: Pretium meant price or value.
items.cn: pretium 意为价格、价值。

items.en: Depretiare meant to lower the price of.
items.cn: depretiare 意为压低…的价格。

items.en: Depreciate entered English for belittling.
items.cn: 十五世纪 depreciate 以贬低义进入英语。

items.en: Depreciation named a fall in currency value.
items.cn: 十八世纪 depreciation 指货币价值下降。

items.en: It became the term for writing off asset cost.
items.cn: 十九世纪成为分摊资产成本的术语。

items.en: It is standard in finance and tax rules.
items.cn: 如今是金融与税务规则中的标准词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the preci- price family; the near-meaning group names other ways value goes down.
note.cn: 形近组共享 preci-（价格）家族；近义组是其他价值下降的说法。

entries.definition: To lose value, or to belittle.
To gain value, or to be grateful.
Having great value or worth.
A deliberate fall in a currency value.
Writing off a cost over a period.
Making something seem unimportant.

normalIntro.en: Depreciation is de- down plus preci- price: the price is pushed down, on a market, in a ledger or in speech.
normalIntro.cn: depreciation 就是 de-（向下）加 preci-（价格）：价格被往下压，在市场上、账本上或言语里。

normal.en: Preci- means price, as in precious.
normal.cn: preci- 意为价格，如 precious。

normal.en: De- means down.
normal.cn: de- 表示向下。

normal.en: Currency depreciation makes imports dearer.
normal.cn: 货币贬值让进口更贵。

normal.en: Depreciation spreads a cost over years.
normal.cn: 折旧把成本分摊到多年。

normal.en: Depreciation of a person is belittling.
normal.cn: 对人的 depreciation 就是贬低。

abstract.en: A rate board with the number moving down.
abstract.cn: 一块数字往下走的汇率牌。

abstract.en: A ledger with one sum crossed off each year.
abstract.cn: 一本每年划掉一笔金额的账簿。

abstract.en: A price tag torn off a good painting.
abstract.cn: 一张从好画上撕下来的价签。

examples.en: Depreciation is charged each year on the fleet.
examples.cn: 车队每年计提折旧。

examples.en: Two depreciations were recorded in the accounts.
examples.cn: 账上记录了两笔折旧。

examples.en: The depreciation of the currency hurt exporters less than expected.
examples.cn: 货币贬值对出口商的伤害小于预期。

dict_mnemonic.text: depreciation ＝ de-（向下）＋ preci（价格，与 price、precious 同根 pretium）＋ -ation（名词）＝把价格往下压：市场上是「贬值」，账本上是「折旧」，对人则是「贬低」。

root: 拉丁语 pretium（价格）→ depretiare（压低价格）→ depreciare → 英语 depreciate ＋ -ation → depreciation

sensesIntro.en: One price pushed down: a rate board, a ledger and a torn tag.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一次被压低的价：一块汇率牌、一本账簿与一张撕下的价签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a new car losing value as it leaves the showroom, a ledger crossing off one sum a year
core.cn: 核心意象：新车开出展厅就掉价，账本上每年划掉一笔折旧

branches.en: A rate board with the number moving down.
branches.cn: 一块数字往下走的汇率牌。

branches.en: A ledger with one sum crossed off each year.
branches.cn: 一本每年划掉一笔金额的账簿。

branches.en: A price tag torn off a good painting.
branches.cn: 一张从好画上撕下来的价签。

branches.en: Both record value going down over time.
branches.cn: 两者都记录价值随时间下降。

branches.en: Both are judgements made by a person.
branches.cn: 两者都是人作出的判断。

intro.en: Depreciation is de- plus preci-; the price root builds the value and praise family.
intro.cn: depreciation 由 de- 加 preci- 构成；价格这个词根造出价值与赞赏一族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin pretium means price, depretiare to lower it and valere to be worth.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pretium 意为价格，depretiare 意为压低它，valere 意为有价值。

definition_en: to make someone feel sad, to lower a level or value, or to press something down
core_image: 一只手掌按在弹簧上，弹簧一点点被压短
scene: 消息传来，屋里没人说话，有人把脸埋进手里。The bad news depressed everyone in the room.
sceneCN: 这里 depress 指「使沮丧」（第 1 个义项：让人情绪低落）；句意是坏消息让屋里所有人都很沮丧。

senses.title: Make someone sad
senses.definition: to make a person feel low and unhappy
senses.definitionCN: 让人情绪低落、不快乐
senses.example: The bad news depressed everyone in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 坏消息让屋里所有人都很沮丧。
senses.why: A feeling can be pressed down like a spring.
senses.whyCN: 心情也能像弹簧一样被压下去。

senses.title: Lower a level or value
senses.definition: to reduce the amount, price or strength of something
senses.definitionCN: 减少某物的数量、价格或强度
senses.example: A flood of imports depressed prices.
senses.exampleCN: 大量进口压低了价格。
senses.why: A market also has a level, and it can be pushed under.
senses.whyCN: 市场也有水位，也能被按到下面。

senses.title: Press down
senses.definition: to push something down with your hand or foot
senses.definitionCN: 用手或脚把某物向下压
senses.example: Depress the pedal slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 慢慢踩下踏板。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a plain downward push.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的意思：一个朴素的向下推。

intro.en: Depress comes from Latin deprimere, built from de-, down, and premere, to press.
intro.cn: depress 来自拉丁语 deprimere，由 de-（向下）与 premere（压）组成。

items.en: Deprimere joined de-, meaning down, with premere, to press.
items.cn: deprimere 由 de-（向下）与 premere（压）合成。

items.en: It described pushing something physically downward.
items.cn: 它描述把某物在物理上向下压。

items.en: English used depress for pressing down.
items.cn: 英语用 depress 表示向下压。

items.en: Trade gave it the sense of lowering prices and spirits.
items.cn: 商业给了它压低价格与情绪的意思。

items.en: Now it covers mood, money and buttons.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖心情、金钱与按钮。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depress stem, and the meaning group gives three downward actions.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depress 词干，近义组则给出三种向下的动作。

entries.definition: feeling very low and unhappy
making people feel low
a long low mood or a low economy
entries.definitionCN: 长期低落的情绪或低迷的经济

entries.definition: to make someone feel sad
to move something down
to push firmly against something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a thumb on a spring and end with a market that has lost its level.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从按在弹簧上的拇指开始，落到一个失去水平线的市场。

normal.en: De- is down and press is press: to press down.
normal.cn: de- 是向下，press 是压，合起来就是往下压。

normal.en: Bad news works like a hand on a spring.
normal.cn: 坏消息的作用，就像一只手按在弹簧上。

normal.en: A price can be depressed without anyone touching it.
normal.cn: 价格可以在没人碰它的情况下被压低。

normal.en: A button and a mood both go down under pressure.
normal.cn: 按钮和心情，都会在压力下下去。

normal.en: Depress is the verb behind depressed and depression.
normal.cn: depress 是 depressed 与 depression 背后的动词。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing a metal spring shorter and shorter.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把金属弹簧越压越短。

abstract.en: Picture a room where everyone looks at the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋里，所有人都看着地面。

abstract.en: Picture a foot easing a pedal down.
abstract.cn: 想象一只脚慢慢把踏板踩下。

examples.en: The bad news depressed everyone in the room.
examples.cn: 坏消息让屋里所有人都很沮丧。

examples.en: A flood of imports depressed prices.
examples.cn: 大量进口压低了价格。

examples.en: Depress the pedal slowly.
examples.cn: 慢慢踩下踏板。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 depress 记成「往下压」：de 是向下，press 是压，把人的心情往下压，就是使沮丧。

root: 来自拉丁语 deprimere，由 de-（向下）与 premere（压）组成。它先表示把东西向下压，十四世纪进入英语；十七世纪商业又给了它压低价格的意思，同时也用来形容情绪被压下去。

sensesIntro.en: From a hand pressing a spring, to prices falling, to a pedal going down.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手压弹簧，到价格下落，再到踏板被踩下。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a palm flattens a spring until it cannot rise.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掌把弹簧按到再也弹不起来。

branches.en: The first sense is a feeling pushed down out of sight.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是被按到看不见的心情。

branches.en: The second sense is a number pushed to a lower level.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被按到更低位置的数字。

branches.en: The third sense is the plain physical push.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是最朴素的物理推压。

branches.en: The language treats a mood as something with a surface.
branches.cn: 这种语言把心情当成有表面的东西。

branches.en: A price and a pedal both go down when force is applied.
branches.cn: 价格与踏板，受力时都会往下走。

intro.en: Depress stands at the centre of a family of low moods, low prices and chemical depressants.
intro.cn: depress 站在一族词的中心，周围是低落的情绪、低迷的价格与抑制类药物。

latinIntro.en: The base is premere, to press, with de- meaning down.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 premere（压），前缀 de- 表示向下。

items.meaning: to push down or make low
items.example: Do not depress the red switch.

items.meaning: a low mood or a low economy
in a way that lowers the mood
a substance that slows the body
a drug that lifts low mood
items.exampleCN: 医生给他换了抗抑郁药。

definition_en: a long feeling of sadness, a period of low economic activity, or a hollow in a surface
core_image: 一片凹下去的地面，雨水积在最低处，久久不退
scene: 雨停之后，操场中间积了一小片水，四周都比它高。The depression of the ground held water for days.
sceneCN: 这里 depression 指「凹陷」（第 3 个义项：表面上凹下去的地方）；句意是地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。

senses.title: A long feeling of sadness
senses.definition: a medical condition or a long period of deep sadness
senses.definitionCN: 一种医学状态或长期的深切悲伤
senses.example: He has struggled with depression for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他与抑郁抗争了多年。
senses.why: Sadness that will not lift becomes an illness with a name.
senses.whyCN: 迟迟不散去的悲伤，成了一种有名字的病。

senses.title: A period of low business
senses.definition: a long period when business is bad and many lose work
senses.definitionCN: 生意低迷、许多人失业的长期时期
senses.example: The depression closed half the shops in town.
senses.exampleCN: 萧条让镇上半数店铺关了门。
senses.why: An economy can sink the way a floor can sink.
senses.whyCN: 经济会下沉，就像地面会下陷。

senses.title: A hollow in a surface
senses.definition: a place where a surface is pressed or worn down
senses.definitionCN: 表面被压下去或磨下去的地方
senses.example: The depression of the ground held water for days.
senses.exampleCN: 地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply a place pressed down.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思，就是一个被压下去的地方。

intro.en: Depression is the Latin noun depressio, from deprimere, to press down.
intro.cn: depression 是拉丁语名词 depressio，来自 deprimere（向下压）。

items.en: Deprimere meant to press down, from de- and premere.
items.cn: deprimere 意为向下压，由 de- 与 premere 组成。

items.en: Depressio named a sinking or a low place.
items.cn: depressio 指下陷或低洼处。

items.en: English used depression for a hollow or a lowering.
items.cn: 英语用 depression 表示凹陷或降低。

items.en: It described low spirits and, later, low trade.
items.cn: 它先形容低落的精神，后来又形容低迷的贸易。

items.en: The Great Depression fixed the economic sense worldwide.
items.cn: 大萧条让经济这一层意思在全世界固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depress stem, and the meaning group gives a mood word, an economic word and a shape word.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depress 词干，近义组则分别给出情绪词、经济词与形状词。

entries.definition: to press down or make low
feeling very low
relating to low mood
the feeling of being unhappy
a period when business shrinks
an empty space inside something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with rain filling a low patch of ground and end with a shop that closes for good.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从雨水积在低洼处开始，落到一家再也不开门的店。

normal.en: Water finds the lowest place, and so does the word depression.
normal.cn: 水找最低处，depression 这个词也一样。

normal.en: A low economy and a low mood are both called a depression.
normal.cn: 低迷的经济与低落的心情，都叫 depression。

normal.en: A depression in the ground keeps what falls into it.
normal.cn: 地面的凹陷会留住落进去的东西。

normal.en: The Great Depression put the word on every front page.
normal.cn: 大萧条把这个词放上了每一份头版。

normal.en: Depression is the noun behind depress, depressed and depressive.
normal.cn: depression 是 depress、depressed 与 depressive 背后的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a shallow bowl of ground holding a mirror of water.
abstract.cn: 想象地上浅浅一只碗，盛着一面水镜。

abstract.en: Picture a street of shops with shutters down.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街的店铺都拉下了卷帘。

abstract.en: Picture a person sitting in a room with the curtains closed.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在拉着窗帘的房间里。

examples.en: He has struggled with depression for years.
examples.cn: 他与抑郁抗争了多年。

examples.en: The depression closed half the shops in town.
examples.cn: 萧条让镇上半数店铺关了门。

examples.en: The depression of the ground held water for days.
examples.cn: 地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 depression 记成「地压深」：de 向下，press 压，ion 名词尾，地被压出一个深坑，就是凹陷，也指心情的低谷。

root: 来自拉丁语 depressio，源头是 deprimere（向下压）。它最早指地面上的低洼处，十四世纪进入英语；十七世纪起用来形容低落的精神与低迷的商业，二十世纪的大萧条让经济这一层意思传遍世界。

sensesIntro.en: From a hollow that holds rain, to a mood that will not lift, to an economy that will not move.
sensesIntro.cn: 从盛着雨水的凹陷，到迟迟不散的低落，再到迟迟不动经济。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rain gathers in the lowest patch and stays there.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨水聚在最低处，久久不退。

branches.en: The first sense is a mood with no way up.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是找不到出口的心情。

branches.en: The second sense is an economy stuck at a low level.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是卡在低位的经济。

branches.en: The third sense is the oldest: a place pressed below its edges.
branches.cn: 第三个义项最古老：一个低于四周的地方。

branches.en: Both a person and a market can be said to be in a depression.
branches.cn: 人与市场，都可以说陷在 depression 里。

branches.en: A low economy and a low patch of ground share the same picture.
branches.cn: 低迷的经济与低洼的地面，共用同一幅图。

intro.en: Depression is the noun at the centre of the pressing family, from the verb to the medical adjective.
intro.cn: depression 是「压」这一族词中心的名词，从动词一直连到医学形容词。

latinIntro.en: The base is premere, to press, with de- meaning down and -ion making a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 premere（压），de- 表示向下，-ion 构成名词。

items.meaning: a low mood, a low economy or a hollow
to push down or make low
items.example: Do not depress the red switch.

items.meaning: in a way that lowers the mood
a substance that slows the body
a drug that lifts low mood
items.exampleCN: 医生给他换了抗抑郁药。
